reviewer: Analyst/Designer subagent simulation; independent local review
execution_ready_semantics: Ready to launch the registered real FLOWR GPU numerical/zero-control test. This is not evidence that the new loss has passed GPU validation or improves affinity.
verdict_zh: 可进入真实 GPU 验证。实际 Agent 行为、统计复算、条件坐标导数、编译绑定及注册策略通过本地审阅；新家族的实际 FLOWR FD、全100步零剂量一致性及亲和力效果仍未执行。

statistical_review.source_scope: 14 discovery batches 0–13; 50 actual score nodes 0.00–0.49, proposal state times up to 0.50. No .51/t1 state enters regional discovery.
statistical_review.observational_label: High versus low contemporaneous model-score quartiles within the original Steer candidate populations. Not a causal binding label, a prospective affinity-gain test, or an expected-resampling-probability contrast.

definitions.regional_features: 20 Gaussian regions × (normalized soft mass, local mean offset xyz, six central covariance entries). Fixed receptor frame; no atom type features.
definitions.units: soft mass dimensionless; local offsets Å; covariance entries Å². Off-diagonals are raw covariance entries, not sqrt(2)-weighted svec.
definitions.scale: Maximum of 1e-6 and the arithmetic mean of candidate standard deviations across batches and nodes, separately per field. It is not a root-balanced or parent-balanced variance estimator.
definitions.parents: For node j>0, use selected_indices at preceding actual node j−1; subtract the corresponding previous candidate forecast, then equal-average children within each extant parent and score stratum. First node has no observed parent edge.
definitions.inference: Equal-batch t test and 2000 batch-bootstrap draws, seed42. Joint BH over all600 field/measure hypotheses.
definitions.parent_edge_rate: Sum of actual high−low parent-edge feature increments over j=1…49, divided by field scale and elapsed .49; no trapezoid or first-placeholder contribution.
definitions.node_functions: Exact observed 50-node mean contrasts and centered/one-sided finite-difference time derivatives. No per-node significance or simultaneous derivative bands are supplied.

statistical_review.raw_trajectory_review_scope: Reviewed selected-parent indexing and recorder semantics; recomputed all compact statistics and actual node functions. Did not re-run the HDF5 mining or independently rehash all fourteen original trajectories in this review.

selected_region.interpretation: An exploratory localization for prototype agreement, not a constant positive occupancy force or an independently causal residue.

limitations: Only current-parent offspring multiplicity is removed. Shared root ancestry, selection-conditioned survival and clone-dependent candidate scale remain.
The 63 supported fields span all20 overlapping Gaussian regions; this does not identify20 independent affinity motifs or prove local specificity beyond a global change.

47 covariance enrichment fields have q<.05: 41 negative and6 positive. Negative off-diagonal covariance changes are not equivalent to smaller spread, and positive diagonal counterexamples rule out universal compression.
Discovery-region choice and the many registered round comparisons remain adaptive. Fourteen stochastic batches, not700 rows or35000 candidates, are the inferential replication units for this mining.
Nonnegative excess distance is guaranteed against the geometric nearest teacher; it is not an affinity benefit.
Compressed and full teacher-score correlations are descriptive, not fitted predictors, a tested paired difference, or evidence that full matching explains R7. Compressed correlation is higher here.

Constant labels/constant scores produce undefined correlation, encoded as0 in V1. The two tables contain7/22 zero cells, which cannot be separated into exact-zero versus undefined from saved summaries. These are not complete valid-correlation means and do not set force direction.

Leave-one-batch teacher exclusion removes the query batch from teacher matching only. Feature selection/scales/salience were learned from the full discovery set; this is not nested heldout validation.

Proper rigid RMS uses a fixed Hungarian correspondence; it is not the global rotation-permutation optimum. Information summaries do not evaluate the complete score-weighted loss or its actual FLOWR Jacobian.
Time rates are descriptors in generation-time units. The first-last change and whole-window slope can disagree in sign; neither is a spatial force.

formula.matching: Hungarian full-cloud correspondence and K nearest teachers in the fixed receptor frame, computed at A and held fixed in differentiation.
formula.prior: log π=log_softmax(−mean squared matched anchor distance/T_A² + β*(recorded_teacher_score−mean_recorded_teacher_score))
formula.pullback: g_t=(∂Yθ/∂x_t)^T ∂R/∂Y with fixed current self-conditioning, attention, teacher identities and assignments; no affinity branch enters loss.

reward_review.units: q, rho and tau are in Å²; delta and radius in Å. The monitoring name nearest_standardized_rms denotes a physical attention-weighted RMS in Å for this family, not a standardized z distance.
reward_review.bounds: R<=0, with no finite lower bound. A positive background preserves direct endpoint force outside the selected region; it is not a hard local support.
runtime_limits: Attention, assignments, K-neighbor selection and priors are recomputed once at each native endpoint, then frozen for the conditional derivative. Recomputing them under ±epsilon would test a different total derivative.
The reward keeps distinct teacher coordinates but its soft mixture can still blend their directions; it does not guarantee a physically realizable final molecule or retention of a single mode.
The actual FLOWR VJP may distribute a regional endpoint force broadly over x_t. This is spatial emphasis, not proof that other atoms are uncontrolled.
All25 active slots enter the point cloud independent of hard atom types. Native graph/category changes remain free; chemical validity and physics must be evaluated independently.

The gradient is evaluated at pre-native x_t and injected after native integration/category updates. It is a lagged local direction; first_order_reward_change is not a measured post-native endpoint response.

Global reward multiplication usually cancels under per-particle gradient normalization. Eta, predictive-flow calibration, schedule and caps determine delivered dose; attention changes the direction and relative spatial weighting.

One existing target forward per production step; no added target/head forward. Native diagnostic off-target calls are retained, not rewarded. Four additional one-time FD forwards are separately counted; new full-zero generation is a separate test.
No SMC/resampling, cloning or graph acceptance gate in gradient arms. The inherited geometric clash safeguard can reduce coordinate displacement; it is not an energy minimizer or candidate selection.

mutation_cases_rejected: identity derivative instead of FLOWR VJP
actual_agent_review.selection_summary: The literal response preserves measured discovery R7, selects region0 by the stipulated reproducible-positive-mass rule, reports both negative endpoint signs, R9 active-control regression, R10 stronger-dose counterexample and the higher compressed teacher-score correlation.
actual_agent_review.interpretation: The first parameter values are prescribed by the registered evidence-constrained intervention. Passing this behavioral module test is not independent evidence of LLM superiority or affinity causality.

campaign_review.scope: R12–26 registered adaptive discovery; maximum30 unchanged. R27–30 use one frozen discovery winner, fresh paired batches and no retuning from validation/heldout.
campaign_review.shared_parameter_cleanup: PERSISTENT_KEYS now excludes shared teacher_score_beta and mixture_temperature. Independent factory evaluations confirmed beta6 and beta0 survive cleanup and produce distinct values/gradients; regional tau.5 is preserved.
campaign_review.fixture_limits: R12–30 route checks used actual completed R1–10 and deliberately inferior synthetic future outcomes; these are software fixtures, not predictions or reported experiments. Regional salience winner was separately frozen exactly.
design_interpretations: R12 is the R7 full-cloud eta=.867 dose trial. R13 is the literal regional trial with unguided/zero/gradient arms, matched eta=.3.
R15 expands to all20 correlated supported regions. It does not test20 independent local mechanisms.
R16 K=1 gives normalized prior1, so beta/teacher temperature cannot affect that conditional loss; label it a single-teacher experiment.
R18 changes both K and teacher temperature and is not a one-factor causal comparison.
R22 uses clip(abs(observed regional effect),.1,2) as attention amplitude, not a signed spatial force or a hard time gate.

Dose refinements retain the globally measured viable affinity parent. Secondary physical tie-breaking is within the predeclared .01 gain tolerance after gain>=.05, not a strict maximum in every later round.

Frozen update_program and apply_regional_fields preserve effective formula, prior, dose and stage functions. Driver changes round/provenance/baseline metadata only; fresh native labels replace inherited R6 labels after26.
campaign_review.continuation: Source routes flowr_endpoint_vjp to the endpoint entry point; complete100 integration steps are enforced, active updates span0→.01 through.49→.50, and .50→1 stays native. Real-run certificates must confirm these source contracts.

tests.independent_numeric_scope: Actual frozen teacher library evaluated on CPU at t=0,.10,.25,.40,.49; NumPy vs Torch scalar, conditional FD, permutation/type invariance, float32 dtype, nonlinear CPU surrogate VJP and shared parameter routes. The surrogate is not FLOWR.

regional_monitoring_amendment.scope: Existing trace aggregation and missing-value retention only; no GPU inference.

required: New-family actual FLOWR FD with fixed attention/assignment/prior/cond and restored audit RNG, four one-time forwards explicitly counted.
New-family complete100-step zero/native tensors and recorded scores must match; preserve failure denominators and 50-window-update/after-window zero-injection evidence.
Check actual one-production-target-forward counts, detached head flags, delivered spatial dose, finite values and native continuation.
Measure final all/valid/unique/best/Top5 head scores, valid/PB, diversity and energy coverage separately; discovery benefit does not establish heldout or biochemical affinity gains.

source_hash_semantics: Exact local bytes; source/control/data/input/response/audit/compiled artifacts are immutable reviewed dependencies. Cross-platform LF/CRLF byte differences are not normalized here. Dynamic campaign state and round outcomes are excluded.

analysis_retention_amendment.scope: Local analysis/retention only; the loss, inference, Skill/input/literal response and compiled program did not change.
analysis_retention_amendment.data_origin: Per-step existing guidance_trace records only; no model/geometry recomputation is added for these four columns.
analysis_retention_amendment.reduction: Arithmetic mean across molecules in each batch/time row; absent keys map to None and remain missing after CSV serialization.
interpretation_limits: Attention min/max are averages of molecule-level extrema, not a global minimum/maximum or normalized attention.
Core fraction refers to the detached endpoint anchor and declared radius. The region is geometric, not an independently causal residue.

Noncore fraction is the mean of per-molecule squared-injection fractions, including runtime zero-injection values encoded0; it is not the fraction of total batch squared injection or a statistic conditional on nonzero dose.
Presence of unequal attention weights and noncore-dose summaries supports runtime diagnosis, not affinity causality or proof that surrounding atoms are unmodified.
The initial256-test full-suite record predates this analysis-only amendment; only the new relevant test was independently rerun.

independent_tests.additional_fixture: Exact four arithmetic means checked; missing-key output and CSV round-trip preserve missing values.
